text:
Lane Hutson plays almost 25 minutes a night at 22, and he is doing what he did in his Calder season: setting up everybody. He has 14 assists among his 17 points, and his 5-game point streak is all assists, seven of them.

Evolving-Hockey ranked him 1st of 215 defensemen in wins above replacement in 2025-26, driven by even-strength offense, with the note that his results that year ran ahead of his chances. This season Montreal takes 59% of expected goals at 5-on-5 with him on, 12 points better than without him. The Canadiens have also scored 3.7 more goals than their chances deserve with him out there, so expect his pace to ease a little, not collapse.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows the style: he carries the puck in on 54% of his entries, and carry-ins led to a chance 25% of the time against 8% for dump-ins. His speed bursts rank in the 95th percentile. Our range has him at 64 to 90 points.
headline: Hutson keeps setting tables in Montreal
